tokens.v: His wrist turns up mid-stretch at a foggy trailhead gate, the titanium case and stone-grey strap sharp against a charcoal running shell sleeve, breath fogging in the cold while pines dissolve into mist behind. 105mm at f/2.2 at chest height a stride away, the case flank catching one cold specular, MERIDIAN laser-etched crisp and legible along it. His other hand grips the wooden gate post out of focus in the near-left, cut by the edge; a trail marker's red blaze floats soft in the background. Full running kit: charcoal shell, black tights, trail shoes.
